title: Missing promised pin-delta.json must fail delivery
changedFact: h04-ap-caller-pin 1.0.0→1.0.1 (version+integrity+resolved). A complete lockfile-pin-delta run would write pin-delta.json and pin-delta.md with stdout ok:true.
